scope: Projectile broadphase; unchanged 60Hz simulation / 240Hz collisions, weapons, roster and AI
limitations: Scale scenarios are synthetic Earth/Earth DeepSpace fights in one shared world, 40 km start, 15 s warmup + 60 s measured, three isolated repetitions. Not multiplayer/render/network FPS.
24/48/96/240 ships assume 1/2/4/10 canonical 12-ship groups per side; final player squad size is not specified.
Per-tick latency includes the profiler. Separate six-job 240-battle validation is not used for performance conclusions.
Large-scene terrain, prolonged debris, other designs and hardware, network costs and manual play feel are unverified.
Preliminary scale measurements identified a remaining carrier scan; the second preliminary repetition was deliberately stopped. Only final root-level scale data feeds this report.
Navigation comparison excludes nondeterministic buildMs and planMs only.
